claims.text: The proposed interlayer is a compositionally graded refractory high-entropy alloy containing targeted Ta and Hf additions.
The graded refractory HEA will effectively bridge W and CuCrZr.
The proposed HEA will provide a coefficient of thermal expansion intermediate between those of W and CuCrZr.
Ta and Hf additions will enhance the chemical inertness of the interlayer.
The proposed interlayer will reduce interfacial stresses and mitigate deleterious chemical reactions under fusion-reactor conditions.
A direct W/CuCrZr interface suffers from significant thermal-expansion mismatch.
Chemical incompatibility at a direct W/CuCrZr interface causes stress concentration and potential interfacial degradation under extreme thermal and irradiation conditions.
Fusion-reactor divertor operation exposes joints to temperatures of at least 1000 K, high heat flux, thermal cycling, and neutron irradiation.
A compositionally graded refractory HEA can provide a continuous transition in thermal and mechanical properties across the W/CuCrZr interface.
A gradual transition in thermal-expansion coefficient and chemistry minimizes mechanical stress accumulation.
A gradual compositional transition limits interdiffusion and brittle-phase formation at the interface.
Reduced stress accumulation and fewer interfacial reactions will enhance bonding integrity and durability.
The graded HEA interlayer will reduce residual interfacial stress relative to direct W/CuCrZr bonding.
The graded HEA interlayer will reduce deleterious bondline reactions and improve long-term mechanical stability.
Directly bonded W/CuCrZr joints typically fail prematurely under extreme thermal and irradiation conditions because of interfacial stress and chemical incompatibility.
The success of the interlayer depends on precise control of its graded composition during manufacturing.
Prolonged neutron irradiation may cause unforeseen phase changes or embrittlement in the proposed graded HEA.
Refractory HEAs have shown promising thermal stability and irradiation resistance under extreme conditions.
